dimensions.assessment: Affects data center operators, local governments negotiating development agreements, and members of the public seeking information.
dimensions.evidence: To limit the enforceability of predispute nondisclosure contract clauses relating to the building of data centers

dimensions.assessment: Invalidates certain legal contracts and prevents data center operators from receiving public tax incentives if they require confidentiality regarding building information.
dimensions.evidence: a covered predispute nondisclosure clause shall be void and unenforceable in judicial and arbitration proceedings

dimensions.assessment: May impact local and state government tax incentives and economic development agreements for data centers.
dimensions.evidence: A data center operator may not receive any public incentive that is conditioned on consent

dimensions.assessment: Applies federal limitations on state, local, and tribal contract enforceability and public incentive programs for large facilities over 50 megawatts.
dimensions.evidence: maximum rated power capacity or projected peak power load of greater than 50 megawatts

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to claims filed on or after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: This Act shall only apply with respect to a claim that is filed... on or after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Number of existing data center contracts affected nationwide.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill voids predispute nondisclosure contract clauses related to building data centers when public officials are parties or public funds/incentives are involved, and bars public incentives for operators using gag clauses.
